name: Talking About Others
overview: Scripture instructs believers to be cautious and discerning in how they speak about others, warning against associating with the ungodly or engaging in harmful gossip, as seen in Psalms 1:1 and Proverbs 11:13. There is a divine timing for every action and word, reminding us to speak with wisdom and purpose (Ecclesiastes 3:1). Jesus teaches the importance of honesty and integrity in our speech (Matthew 5:33) and calls us to treat others as we desire to be treated (Matthew 7:12), reflecting a Christ-centered approach to communication. Ultimately, our words should bear witness to the truth and light of Christ, encouraging faith in Him (John 1:7).
